title: Chunk prefix of the configuration word
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, let $C$ be a configuration of $N$ on input $x$, and let $s\in\mathbb{N}$. The first $W(2s+1)$ bits of the encoded configuration word are exactly the concatenation of the encoded chunks for the cells of that configuration.
hypotheses_covered: A finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols
